# trackiwi-client

> Unofficial, read-only Python client (library + CLI) for pulling one person's
> own GPS data out of a personal [trackiwi](https://www.trackiwi.com) account:
> sync positions into a local SQLite cache and export them as GPX, GeoJSON or
> CSV. Zero runtime dependencies — standard library only. MIT-licensed (see
> LICENSE). Unaffiliated with trackiwi; it talks to the private API the vendor's
> own app uses.

## Overview

- Read-only by construction: the only state-changing request is
  `DELETE /api/v2/session` (`logout`). No writes to tours, markers, alarms or
  shares are implemented, ever.
- Runs installed (`trackiwi …`) or straight from a clone (`python -m trackiwi …`),
  since there are no dependencies to resolve.

- [README](README.md): install, usage, exit codes, and the security posture.
- [Design spec](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-17-trackiwi-client-design.md): the

- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what is sensitive and how to report a concern.
- [Requirements & traceability](docs/requirements.rst): every requirement as a
  `sphinx-needs` object, each traced to its verifying test in
  [docs/traceability.rst](docs/traceability.rst); the docs build fails in CI if
  any requirement has no verifying test.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT.

## Module map (hard boundaries)

- `trackiwi/client.py`: network I/O only (auth, sync, the read-only list reads).
- `trackiwi/store.py`: SQLite cache only.
- `trackiwi/export.py`: pure functions producing GPX / GeoJSON / CSV.
- `trackiwi/cli.py`: command wiring and all user interaction.
- `trackiwi/__init__.py`: shared contracts — `TrackiwiError`, `AuthError`, the
  `COLUMNS` tuple, `__version__`. `client.py` and `store.py` never import each
  other.
- `trackiwi/lineprotocol.py` — pure: cached row → InfluxDB line protocol (natural units)
- `trackiwi/influx.py` — InfluxDB target config, version detection, writes, `check`, and the resumable `mirror`
- `deploy/` — Docker Compose stack, Grafana provisioning + portable Flux dashboard, systemd timer

## Read-only API surface covered

- `POST /api/login`, `GET`/`DELETE /api/v2/session` (auth and revocation).
- `POST /api/v2/trackers/sync` (the CSV position feed, cached).
- `GET /api/v2/trackers` and the read-only lists `GET /api/v2/tours`,
  `/api/v2/markers`, `/api/v2/marker_categories`, `/api/v2/alarms`,
  `/api/v2/shares` (live reads, not cached).

## Security posture

The position cache and the plaintext token are movement history of a real
vehicle and are treated as secrets; the repo commits no private data (see
SECURITY.md and the README Security section).
